Abstract.AbstractText: Inflammatory arthropathy predominantly affecting the axial skeleton can cause pain, stiffness, disability, and ankylosis. This article discusses the use of cross-sectional imaging in the domain of inflammatory pelvic and axial arthropathy highlighting the key distinguishing features of common known diseases and their differential diagnoses.
